Features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
Features.subtitle: Powerful enough for data nerds. Simple enough for everyday use.

heatmap.title: Contribution Heatmap
heatmap.description: A year of effort turned into one honest picture. Every habit gets its own color-coded grid, so you spot patterns, gaps, and streaks at a glance.

streaks.title: Smart Streaks
streaks.description: Streaks that understand your schedule, so a planned rest day never breaks them. Gym Monday, Wednesday, Friday? Three sessions, three-day streak.

reminders.title: Daily Reminders
reminders.description: A morning overview of today's habits and an evening nudge to log before bed. Motivational messages that rotate daily.

pace.title: Track Pace & Speed
pace.description: Log distance and time for running and biking. Auto-calculate pace (min/km) or speed (km/h) in real time.

charts.title: Per-Habit Statistics
charts.description: Consistency, averages, totals, and best days. Swipe through your full history with daily values, 7-day averages, and goal lines.

private.title: 100% Private
private.description: No accounts. No cloud. No tracking. All data stays on your iPhone. We literally cannot see your data.

languages.title: 25+ Languages
languages.description: From English to Japanese, Arabic to Albanian. Track your habits in your language, with flag icons.

customizable.title: Flexible Tracking
customizable.description: Track daily, on specific days, or simply whenever. Infinite colors, 30+ emoji icons, custom units, and daily targets. Make each habit yours.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Three steps. No setup required beyond the first minute.

step1.title: Log in seconds
step1.description: Tap a habit, enter your value, done. Track distance and time for running and biking, and pace calculates automatically.

step2.title: See your patterns
step2.description: Your heatmap grid shows your entire year at a glance. All habits stacked vertically, so you spot consistency and gaps instantly.

step3.title: Watch yourself grow
step3.description: Swipe through scrollable charts to see your progress compound over time. Smart streaks respect your schedule and only count when you hit your goals.

q1.question: How do I log a habit?
q1.answer: Open the app and tap any habit card on the home screen. A quick-entry sheet appears, type your value (e.g. 7.5 hours of sleep, 2.5L of water) and tap Save. The entry is recorded instantly and your heatmap cell updates.

q2.question: How do I import data from a spreadsheet?
q2.answer: Go to Settings, Data Management, Import CSV. The expected format is two columns: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and value. Export your spreadsheet as CSV, save it to Files, and select it in the import picker. Historical data fills in your heatmap retroactively.

q3.question: Where is my data stored?
q3.answer: All data is stored locally on your iPhone using iOS on-device storage (UserDefaults). Nothing leaves your device, there are no servers, no cloud sync, no accounts. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

q4.question: Can I export my data?
q4.answer: Yes. Go to Settings, Data Management, Export. You can export as JSON (full fidelity, re-importable) or CSV (compatible with Excel, Numbers, Google Sheets). The export file is saved to your Files app.

q5.question: How do I delete all my data?
q5.answer: Go to Settings, Data Management, Clear All Data. You'll see a confirmation prompt. This action is permanent and irreversible, it wipes all habits, logs, and preferences from your device.

q6.question: Will there be an Android version?
q6.answer: We're focused on iOS for now. Building one platform well beats two platforms poorly. Stay tuned.

Tutorial.title: Import Your Data
Tutorial.intro: Already tracking habits? Import your history in minutes.

importLogs.title: Import Daily Logs
importLogs.intro: Import historical data for your habits from a CSV file. Each row represents one day's entry.
importLogs.colHabitDesc: Must match an existing habit name in the app (case-insensitive).
importLogs.colUnitDesc: The habit's unit, for your reference. Examples: hours, minutes, km
importLogs.colNoteDesc: Optional free text. Leave blank or omit entirely.
tips: You can use Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers, just export as .csv or .txt.
Habit names must match exactly: 'Workout' and 'workout' both work, but 'Work out' won't match 'Workout'.
If a date + habit already exists, the import updates the existing value, it does not duplicate it.
You can mix multiple habits in one file.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.intro: Export your entire app data, habits and logs, as a single CSV file. Use it to restore on a new device or keep an offline backup.
restoreSteps: Choose "Merge with existing" or "Replace all data"
Review the summary and tap Import
backup.autoDetect: The app auto-detects whether you're importing a backup (has #HABITS section) or just log entries. One import button handles both.

prebuilt.title: Pre-built Habits
prebuilt.intro: The app comes with 9 default habits ready to track:
prebuilt.note: You can also create unlimited custom habits with your own name, unit, icon, color, and schedule.

reminders.title: Daily Reminders
reminders.intro: MyGrowth can send you two daily notifications:
reminders.morning: Morning Reminder, a summary of your scheduled habits for the day. Default: 9:00 AM.
reminders.evening: Evening Nudge, a gentle reminder to log any habits you missed. Default: 9:00 PM.
reminders.footer: Both are customizable in Settings, Notifications. Messages rotate daily with motivational text.

pace.title: Track Pace & Speed
pace.intro: For habits like Running and Biking, enable "Track time" in the habit settings to log both distance and time. The app auto-calculates:
pace.running: Running to Pace (min/km), e.g. 7 km in 38 min = 5:25 min/km
pace.biking: Biking to Speed (km/h), e.g. 10 km in 30 min = 20.0 km/h
pace.footer: In the Charts tab, switch between Distance, Pace/Speed, or Both views.

streaks.title: How Streaks Work
tips: Logging a value of 0 doesn't count, you must actually do the habit.
Your value must meet the target, 2 hours of sleep (target: 8) won't count.
Streaks respect your schedule, if you work out Monday, Wednesday, Friday and hit all three, that's a 3-day streak. Tuesday and Thursday don't break it.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: MyGrowth ("the App") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data.

short.title: The Short Version
short.body: We don't collect any data. Everything stays on your device.

stored.title: What Data Is Stored
stored.intro: The App stores the following data locally on your iPhone:
items: Daily log entries (date, value, optional notes)
App preferences (theme, onboarding status, consent records)
stored.footer: This data is stored using iOS on-device storage (UserDefaults). It never leaves your device.

notCollect.title: What We Don't Collect
items: No personal information (name, email, phone, location)
No usage analytics or crash reports
No data is transmitted to any server

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: None. The App contains no third-party SDKs, analytics tools, ad networks, or cloud services.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
rights.access: Access your data: visible directly in the app at any time
rights.export: Export your data: via Settings, Data Management, Export (JSON or CSV)
rights.delete: Delete your data: via Settings, Data Management, Clear All Data
rights.rectify: Rectify your data: edit any entry by tapping it in the app
rights.footer: Since all data is stored exclusively on your device, exercising these rights requires no request to us, you have full control.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Your data persists on your device until you delete it within the app or uninstall the app. Uninstalling permanently removes all data.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: The App does not knowingly collect data from children under 16. Since no personal information is collected from any user, the App is compliant with COPPA and GDPR age requirements.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: If we update this policy, we will post the revised version on this page with an updated date.
